title: Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever

path: Where Your Story Begins
changes.text: WoW: Forever begins in the early “Year 1” period of original World of Warcraft, before Kazzak reopened the Dark Portal and before later journeys to places like Northrend reshaped the timeline. The game is built from the original level 1–60 world, expanding events, characters, and locations that exist—or could have existed—within that foundational era. This opens up new opportunities to delve into previously undeveloped areas, experience new tales, and travel roads yet untaken.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Explore New and Reimagined Lands
changes.text: WoW: Forever expands the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor with new and reimagined zones and more than 1,000 new quests across the level 1–60 journey. Explore new destinations including Mount Hyjal, Shen’dralas, the Riverglades, and Zephras Isle.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Brave Nine New Dungeons
changes.text: Nine new five-player dungeons span levels 13–60 across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. Each adds new threats, quests, and stories rooted in the original world.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Brave Nine New Dungeons
changes.text: Eastern Kingdoms: Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Excavation Site, City of Dalaran, The Drowned City, and Krol’dok Stronghold.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Brave Nine New Dungeons
changes.text: Kalimdor: Alcaz Prison, Blackmaw Hold, and Shaper’s Terrace.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
New Class and Race Combinations
changes.text: The Skyborne race adds more choices. This new playable race can join either the Alliance or the Horde at character creation, with unique racial abilities depending on that choice, and begins in the level 1–12 Zephras Isle starting zone. Skyborne can be Druids, Hunters, Rogues, and Warriors; Alliance-aligned Skyborne can also be Mages, while Horde-aligned Skyborne can also be Shaman. Skyborne access requires the purchase of the Heroic Pack or higher digital upgrades.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Make Every Part of the Journey Count with the Legacy System
changes.text: World of Warcraft: Forever introduces an exciting new account-wide horizontal progression system—the Legacy System. It’s a whole new way to progress, focusing on exploring everything the game has to offer, rather than power progression alone.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Battle for the Darkspear Islands
changes.text: Darkspear Islands is a new 15 versus 15 battleground off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh for levels 30–60. Teams earn points by controlling four capture points and securing a central flag; the first team reaching 2,000 points wins.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Battle for the Darkspear Islands
changes.text: Players can build reputation with the Darkspear Raiders or Theramore Expeditionary Force to unlock faction rewards. Read the previously published Darkspear Islands battleground overview for more information.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
See Azeroth the Way You Remember It
changes.text: You can change the selection later or fine-tune your experience in the Options Menu under System – Preset. After your initial log in to the game, you will no longer see this screen.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Make a Name for Yourself—Twice
changes.text: In WoW: Forever, every character has a two-part name, similar to a first name and surname. The complete combination must be unique within your region, giving you more room to carry forward a favorite name or build a new identity.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: Instead of choosing from a long list of realms, players select a Ruleset that matches how they want to experience Azeroth. Each Ruleset operates as its own large ecosystem for grouping, dungeons, raids, and community.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: Normal: Focus on adventuring and fighting monsters, with player-versus-player combat available at your discretion.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: PvP: Focus on player-versus-player combat, with the risk of being attacked by opposing players through much of the open world.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: Roleplay: Enter a community with naming and behavior rules intended for players who want to immerse themselves as characters in a fantasy world.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: Roleplay-PvP: Join an immersive roleplaying community while also facing the danger of open-world conflict with the opposing faction.

path: Discover What Awaits in WoW: Forever
Choose How You Want to Experience Azeroth
changes.text: Hardcore (coming later): Take on a high-stakes challenge where every decision matters and a character’s journey can end with death. Additional details and timing will be shared later.

path: Returning to Azeroth with Account Recovery
changes.text: If you cannot sign in, Blizzard Support offers account-recovery options for locating an account, resetting a password, unlocking access, addressing authenticator issues, and recovering an account when you no longer have access to its email address.

path: Install Battle.net to Get Started
Subscription or Game Time Is Required
changes.text: Access to WoW: Forever is included with an active World of Warcraft subscription or Game Time. Optional upgrade editions include cosmetics and other benefits; access to the Skyborne race and starting experience requires the Skyborne Heroic Pack or higher.
